senses.gloss:
नन्द- + आत्मज नन्द- + आत्मज,
 I. m. a name of Kṛṣṇa, Gīt. 8, 11.
 II. f. जा, a name of Durgā, MBh. 4, 179.
नन्दि- + आवर्त नन्दि- + आवर्त, m. a certain diagram, MBh. 7, 2930.
नन्दीश्वर नन्दीश्वर, i. e. नन्दि- or नन्दिन्-, m. 1. a name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10431. 2. a proper name, Bhāg. P. 4, 2, 20.
नन्दि- + घोष नन्दि- + घोष, m. shout, MBh. 13, 5288.
नाना- + देश्य नाना- + देश्य, adj. belonging to or coming from several countries, MBh. 1, 5221.
नंश् नंश्, see नश्.

ननु न-नु, a particle of interrogation.
 1. Not (Lat. nonne), MBh. 13, 313.
 2. with an imperat. Do, Śiś. 9, 61.
 3. Then, Mṛcch. 174, 12.

नन्द् नन्द् (probably for ननद्, a reduplicated form of नद्), i. 1, Par. (also Ātm., Rām. 2, 84, 4), To be pleased, Rām. 1, 10, 28.
 --Caus. नन्दय, To gladden, Rām. 4, 22, 6.
 --With the prep. अभी,
 1. To be pleased, Bhag. 2, 57.
 2. To be pleased with (acc.), Man. 6, 45.
 3. To desire, MBh. 13, 6655.
 4. To salute, Pañc. 57, 18; with न, sometimes To receive unkindly, MBh. 14, 134.
 5. To take leave from (acc.), MBh. 1, 5751.
 6. To approve, Rām. 4, 10, 33; Śāk. d. 71.
 7. To acknowledge, Man. 8, 54.
 8. With न; sometimes To refuse. MBh. 5, 7505.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. अभिनन्दनिय, अभि-नन्द्य, To be rejoiced at. Śāk. 63, 18; 27, 6.
 --Caus. To exhilarate, Rām. 2, 107, 10.
 --With प्रत्यभि प्रति-अभि, To return a salutation. MBh. 13, 7721.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To congratulate, Kathās. 21, 148.
 --With आ आ, To be pleased, Gīt. 11, 10.
 --Caus. To gratify, Yājñ. 1, 355.
 --With परि परि, Caus. To gratify very mac, MBh. 15, 522.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To salute. MBh. 5, 1806.
 2. To salute in one's turn, Man. 7, 146.
 3. To show one's satisfaction, MBh. 13, 426.
 4. To favour, Kumāras. 7, 87.
 5. To [] receive joyfully, MBh. 1, 7253.
 6. With न, To refuse, 3673. अ-प्रति-नन्दित, Disowned, Bhāg. 4, 4, 8.
 --Caus. To gratify, MBh. 3, 16444.
 --With संप्रति सम्-प्रति, To welcome joyfully, 10, 475.
 --With वि वि, To be pleased, 3, 2607 (Ātm.).

नन्द नन्द् + अ,
 I. m. One of Yudhiṣṭhira's drums, MBh. 7, 1032.
 2. A name of Viṣṇu, 13, 7005.
 3. A proper name (especially of the foster father of Kṛṣṇa and Durgā), 4, 179; 1, 2731.
 4. The name of a mountain, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 21.
 II. f. दा.
 1. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2597.
 2. The name of a river, 7818.
 III. f. दी, A tree, Cedrela toona Roxb., Suśr. 1, 219, 19.
 --Comp.

नन्दक नन्द् + अक,
 I. adj. in देवता-स्तव-, Gladdening the deities by praises, MBh. 13, 7662.
 II. m.
 1. The name of Kṛṣṇa's sword, MBh. 5, 4427.
 2. A proper name, 1, 6983.
नन्दकिन् नन्दकिन्, i. e. नन्दक + इन्, m. A name of Viṣnu (possessed of the sword नन्दक), MBh. 13, 7056.

नन्दन नन्द् + अन,
 I. adj., f. ना, Gladdening, MBh. 3, 11073.
 II. m.
 1. A son, Yājñ. 1, 274.
 2. Epithet of Viṣṇu and Śiva, MBh. 13, 7005; 1189.
 3. A certain plant, Suśr. 2, 251, 19.
 4. A proper name, MBh. 9, 2540.
 5. The name of a mountain, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 21.
 III. n. The pleasure-ground of the gods, especially of Indra, Indr. 2, 3.
 --Comp.
नन्दनक नन्दन + क, a substitute for नन्दन when latter part of a comp. word, MBh. 3, 10856.

नन्दि नन्द् + इ,
 I. m.
 I. Epithet of Viṣṇu and Śiva, MBh. 13, 7015; 1189.
 2. A proper name, 13, 872.
 II. f. (and m. and n.) Joy, MBh. 5, 4600; personified, Bhāg. P. 6, 6, 6.

नान्दी नान्दी, i. e. नन्द् + अ + ई, f.
 1. Joy, MBh. 4, 2189.
 2. A prayer at the opening of a drama, Mṛcch. 1, 8.

नन्दिन् नन्द् + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Liking, MBh. 6, 16.
 2. Gladdening, 13, 4708.
 II. m.
 1. A son, Mṛcch. 47, 21.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 12, 10223.
 III. f. नी,
 1. A daughter, 14, 1841.
 2. The name of a fabulous cow, 1, 3923.
 3. A proper name, 9, 2623.
नाना नाना, adv. Different, Bhāg. P. 1, 2, 32. Often in the beginning of comp. words, Of different classes, Man. 9, 148; various, 257.

नानात्व नाना + त्व, n.
 1. Difference, MBh. 2, 137.
 2. Manifoldness, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 13.
नाना-भाण्ड- + पति नाना-भाण्ड- + पति, m. a great merchant, 26, 11.
नन्द-पुत्री नन्द-पुत्री, f. a name of Durgā.
नन्दि- + मुख नन्दि- + मुख, m. 1. epithet of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10428. 2. a kind of water-fowl, Suśr. 1, 205, 13. 3. a kind of rice, ib. 1, 196, 2.

नान्दी- + मुख नान्दी- + मुख,
 I. adj.
 1. with पितृ, a class of Manes, Yājñ. 1, 249. 2. with or without श्राद्ध, n. an oblation to that class of Manes, Mārk. P. 34, 105.
 II. f. खी, a sort of corn, Suśr. 1, 197, 1.

नाना- + रूप नाना- + रूप,
 I. n. pl. many shapes, Rām. 3, 1, 21 Gorr.
 II. adj. having many shapes, different, Man. 9, 38.

नन्दि- + वर्धन नन्दि- + वर्धन,
 I. adj. causing joy, MBh. 5, 2937.
 II. m. 1. a son, Rām. 6, 112, 4. 2. a proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 13, 14.
नाना- + विध नाना- + विध, adj. of various sorts, Man. 5, 110; manifold, Hit. 46, 14.
